subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Forensic Accounting Basics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Forensic Accounting Basics.

hook.text: Al Capone ran a criminal empire. The IRS brought him down with accounting — tax evasion, not murder.

buildup.text: Forensic accountants follow the money to uncover fraud, embezzlement, and financial crimes.

discovery.text: They analyze bank statements, trace transactions, and reconstruct financial records that fraudsters tried to hide.

twist.text: Forensic accountants often testify in court. Their ability to explain numbers to juries determines convictions.

climax.text: Following the money has solved more white-collar cases than any other investigation method.

punchline.text: Follow the money. It always tells the truth eventually.

quiz.question: How was Al Capone ultimately convicted?
options: Tax evasion uncovered by forensic accounting
